messages:
mara: Heads-up — saw a spike of 413s from a customer hitting the embeddings route with mixed dims and huge arrays. Not a new error but frequency spikes after last night's deploy.

devon: thx. any logs? sample payload?

mara: pasted sanitized snippet below:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Headers: Content-Type: application/json; X-Embed-Dims: 1024
Body: { 
  "input": ["... long array ... repeated 500x"],
  "model": "open-embed-1024"
}
```

toni: ok two things: 1) customer is sending 500 inputs at 1024 dims -> size ~ 500*1024*4 ~ 2MB raw not counting JSON overhead, 2) current splitter rejects >1.5MB and returns 413.

yuan: is the splitter using byte-size only or also dims compatibility? we had an earlier decision to prefer dim-homogeneous batches for performance.

mara: splitter today enforces both. but telemetry shows it sometimes routes mixed-dim to slow fallback which then hits quota throttles.

devon: i think we should try a "softcap" policy instead of hard 413 on first pass: accept request, preflight and return 202 + job-id with background split/route OR immediate partial accept with per-item status. That avoids tight coupling with client retry logic.

toni: hmm that changes the API contract. clients expect sync embeddings. can we make it behind a feature flag + canary in console?

yuan: also need better signals in console. current dashboard only shows 413 counts and generic rate. proposal: add heatmap "payload-size vs dims" and a small table of top offending customers with sample vector counts.

oliver: agree on telemetry. we should add an outgoing event for preflight decisions: {outcome: ACCEPT|SPLIT|REJECT, reason: STRING, incoming_byte_size, dims, batch_count}. we already have something similar but it's coarse.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: rolled deploy/embeds-splitter v2 -> success in prod at 2026-03-19T02:12:11Z (sha abc123).

mara: devon, if we do softcap + 202 job flow, what surface changes for SDKs?

devon: SDKs would expose a new response shape for embeddings: either {synchronous: true, data: [...] } or {synchronous: false, job_id: "...", retry_after: 5}. We can keep old behavior unless flag enabled per-tenant. SDKs can default to legacy sync.

toni: rollout plan: 1) add telemetry events (no UX) -> 2) console feature flag toggle per-tenant for soft-accept -> 3) SDK opt-in beta -> 4) canary 5% -> monitor for user confusion/metrics -> 5) full.

yuan: metric KPIs to monitor: per-tenant 4xx/413 rate, avg latency p50/p95 for embeddings, queue depth for background splitter, and user-facing error ratio after soft-accept. Also alert when job backlog > X for > 10m.

mara: question: for mixed-dims should we still permit multi-dim arrays in same payload at all? Or require header `X-Allow-Mixed-Dims: true`?

oliver: prefer explicit opt-in. default: reject mixed-dims sync calls with 413 + hint header `X-Need-Multi-Dim-Mode`. If tenant enables, allow server-side split with potential async flow. Simpler for infra and performance guarantees.

devon: console UX: when tenant hits repeated 413/mix errors show an in-console suggestion card: "Enable mixed-dim async handling" with estimated cost delta and expected latency. Click-to-enable behind account admin.

toni: telemetry UX: add a small preflight explorer on the per-route view where you can paste a sample payload (or hash) and the console will simulate splitter decision and show estimated split plan. Helps support debugging.

yuan: logging: ensure we redact vectors but record counts and dims. example event we want: `embed.preflight { tenant: t-123, batch_count: 500, dims: 1024, outcome: SPLIT_ASYNC, estimated_splits: 5 }`

mara: security/compliance: async job storage must respect retention & encryption; for private deployments we must allow customer-managed KMS for stored batches. add checklist item.

oliver: ops: what's the rollback if canary causes ops pain? plan to revert feature flag and drain background jobs then revert code. Need runbook.

devon: i'll draft a PR with the API response changes + console flag wiring. can we get observability events added in the same iteration?

toni: let's separate: telemetry events + console telemetry tiles in sprint A; API + SDK soft-accept in sprint B. ops runbook must be ready before B.

mara: thanks. action items: @devon PR for API + SDK spec (due EOD Fri), @yuan add telemetry event schema + grafana panels (due Tue), @oliver add runbook skeleton, @toni wire console toggle design. I'll open tracking tickets.

devon: will post PR link in this thread.

mara: also, customer outreach: @support should reach out to the one who hit spike and offer workaround: reduce batch_count or use separate per-dim calls.

oliver: one more: let's add a lightweight `X-Embed-Preview` header that returns the splitter decision without performing work, for integrations. Could be allowed for admin keys only.

yuan: love that. helps SDKs debug without sending vectors.

mara: great thread. keeping this pinned until PRs + tickets are linked. (reacts with :white_check_mark:)
